title: Password reset approved by the admin, faster repeat answers
changes: If a reset code does not arrive, you can ask the admin to approve your reset and a new code is sent within seconds.
Asking the same question about the same report again answers instantly.

title: Grouped matching and daily settlement
changes: Several rows that add up to one row in the other report are now matched as a group.
A daily settlement table shows expected, settled and outstanding amounts and settlement delays.
Warnings appear when a file mixes currencies.

title: Reconciliation quality score
changes: Every reconciliation now gets a 0-100 quality score with the reason for each part.
Total value affected by differences is shown, and added to the PDF and Excel file.
Rows described as reversals, refunds or failed transactions are flagged for review.

title: More detail in bank statement checks
changes: The statement report now lists every transaction with its date and reference.
Possible duplicates and unusual entries are listed one by one with the reason.
Net movement, credit and debit counts, and a check of how many rows were read are shown.
Rows that hold both a credit and a debit amount are now counted as two transactions.

title: Safer uploads, better matching evidence
changes: Uploads now run in the background with a progress percentage, so large files no longer freeze the page.
Reconciliation results show how confident each match is and what kind of difference it is.
New searchable Help page and a tamper-evident audit log.

title: Faster answers and a bigger question box
changes: Answers are built to finish within about 30 seconds.
The question box is larger and easier to read.
Set your company logo and colour in Settings and they appear on your PDFs.

title: Month-end pack and calculation panel
changes: Download a ZIP with the PDF and Excel file in one click.
Open "How was this calculated?" under any answer to see the steps and assumptions.
Reconciliation differences become cases you can mark resolved.
